Faulting behavior before the far-pointer-load fix:

Guest instruction at ff33:cde6: 26 c4 6d 45, LES BP,[ES:DI+45h].
Expected EBP=c13c13c0; observed EBP=000013c0.
The old model assigns the qword returned by read_far_pointer directly to
the GPR, so this is a model width error rather than a sail-llvm workaround.

SDM rev.090 Vol.2A, LDS/LES/LFS/LGS/LSS, pp.3-540--3-542:
the offset is loaded into r16/r32/r64 according to operand size; segment
validation precedes the destination assignment.
